bosses.name: Vegeta
bosses.location: Hidden area off the main path — look for the giant rock with an invisible opening
tips: The tutorial secret boss — killable early, and the accessory always drops.
Every kill is a rarity roll (Common → Secret). Keep farming until a high roll lands.
Worth returning to at endgame: a Secret Scouter is one of the biggest early Energy boosts.

bosses.name: Levi
bosses.location: Behind a fake wall in the corner of the map
bosses.avatarDrop: Levi Avatar — 12x Energy, 0.01% drop (in-game View Drops panel)
tips: The first secret boss that upgrades your build twice: accessory plus a separate avatar drop.
The 12x Energy Levi Avatar is one of the biggest single upgrades in the game — players camp World 2 for it long after unlocking the portal.
Accessory drops at 100%; only the rarity varies.
bosses.imageAlt: Levi's in-game View Drops panel: 0.01% avatar, 100% accessory, Gold and a 4% raid ticket

bosses.name: Kakashi
bosses.location: Behind the mansion — find the fake wall and DASH through it (walking does not work)
tips: The dash requirement trips up most players — sprint into the fake wall, don't walk.
Gold bonus compounds with Gold events and potions for faster card rolls.
Pair with a Gold event window for the best farming math.
bosses.imageAlt: The Copy Ninja's in-game View Drops panel: 100% accessory, Gold and raid ticket

bosses.name: Meliodas
bosses.location: Under the waterfall near the bridge (below the lake)
bosses.avatarDrop: Meliodas Avatar — 0.01% drop (in-game View Drops panel), the rarest hunt in the game
tips: The final boss accessory in the chain, and it is an Energy roll.
The ~0.01% avatar is a long Drop-potion session, not a one-off visit.
Stack Drop potion + the 1.5x Drop mount before camping him.
bosses.imageAlt: Meliodas's in-game View Drops panel: 0.01% avatar, 100% accessory, Gold and raid ticket

petRules: Each world ships its own pet gacha ('Power' units) on top of the companion card.
A Mythical Power unit is worth 3x Energy; a Secret unit up to 6x (wiki-verified).
A Broken-rarity pet sits above Secret — creator-measured at 150x Energy (single source, treat as approximate).
Simultaneous spins let you hatch up to 5 eggs at once.

mechanics: Race Coins drop from regular enemies (~20% on Alien Planet NPCs) and feed the Races gacha.
Your race is a permanent multiplier slot that stacks with companions, pets, accessories and everything else.
Auto Spin is supported; hover each slot in the Races window to see the boost it rolls.
Re-roll whenever your coin balance comfortably exceeds what you would lose.
races.note: The full race list is not published anywhere we could verify. Three races are confirmed from gameplay footage; the rest are marked as a gap, not guessed.

mechanics: Portals drop in the Hunter raid; open one from your inventory and clear its waves to earn Shadows.
Shadows drop at every portal rank — higher ranks mean better odds.
Shadows come in combat types (Warrior, Healer, Tank) with their own stat lines.
Merge duplicate Shadows upward — Mythical merges into Secret — and a pity guarantees progress.
Shadow passives (rolled separately, e.g. 'Elite') add an Energy multiplier on top.
A shadow enchant gacha rolls up to 6x Energy at Secret rarity.
Portal upgrades (portal coins) raise portal level, up to 50 levels each.
shadows.note: Added in Update 1 alongside Hunter City. Shadow Monarch and Ant King are confirmed by creator footage; the full shadow roster is a known gap.

mechanics: Unlocking the Class Tree costs 1.08 Qi Gold (in-game unlock dialog).
Six branches grow from the center; new branches grow out of the first one. Drag and zoom to explore.
Nodes increase your multipliers; unlocking nodes costs Hunter class coins.
Hunter class coins drop in Hunter City and in the Hunter raid portals.
Awakening a class costs 1,000 coins (creator-observed); further nodes run about 5,000 each.
Nodes can also be bought with Gems.
classTree.note: The individual class names on the tree are not yet published in any verifiable source. That list is a gap we are filling from gameplay, not from guesswork.

mechanics: Unlocking the totem costs 41.3T Gold (in-game unlock dialog).
10 stages; each stage needs 10 Commandment Fragments and the cost grows every stage.
Stage rewards include Energy, Damage, Gold, card luck, card speed, card spins, gacha luck, crit damage — and +1 hero equip slot.
A fragment appears around Sin Village every 30 minutes, stays for 15 minutes, then vanishes.
Each player gets their own fragment at a random spot; one fragment per appearance.
Fragments stop appearing once your totem is maxed.

redeemSteps: Finish the tutorial — the Shop stays locked until you clear it.
Open the Shop and look for the small ticket icon at the bottom-left, next to the F2P Info button.
The redeem panel opens on top of the Exclusive Shop — if you only see packs and a countdown timer, you are in the wrong panel.
Enter the code exactly as written (codes are case-sensitive) and confirm.
